name: INVITED
label: Invited
description: User has been invited but has not completed registration.

name: ACTIVE
label: Active
description: User can authenticate and use the platform.

name: LOCKED
label: Locked
description: User is temporarily locked out, e.g. after failed logins.

name: SUSPENDED
label: Suspended
description: User access has been suspended by an administrator.

name: DEACTIVATED
label: Deactivated
description: User account has been permanently deactivated.
